reason: No FRED/ALFRED-mirrored, vintage-archived series exists for the natural indicator (CMS Health Insurance Marketplace effectuated enrollment). CMS publishes effectuated enrollment as point-in-time snapshot reports (fact sheets / state XLSX), which the house ALFRED first-print fetcher cannot resolve, so the unit fails the first-print bar and is classified dose-response-only (unscored) rather than dropped.
